title: meeting_candidates
description: A meeting-shaped email found by scanning Gmail (T-028: Gmail meeting-candidate approval workflow). Never auto-ingested as a real session — a human approves it first, or the sending pattern has already earned trust (see trusted_senders). One row per real Gmail message, deduped by messageId.

messageId.description: The real Gmail message id — dedup key.

threadId.description: Literal Gmail thread identity for registration-confirmation correlation.

registrationUrl.description: Literal registration URL from acquisition; not proof of submission or confirmed attendance.

kind.description: U2 source-watcher: whether the body's own links/text describe a recording of a session already held, or an invite to one still to come.

startTime.description: U2: parsed from the body's own stated date/time (e.g. 'Day & Date: ... Time: 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM IST'). Absent when the body states no time.

recordingUrl.description: U2: a Drive/YouTube/Zoom-recording link found in the body, distinct from meetingUrl (the live join link).

registrationOnly.description: Registration is required: scheduling stays barred until verified direct join evidence. Approved automated registration must retain this barrier until confirmation; this field grants no submission permission.
